newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - April 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - April 11.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Friday:
* A Federal judge struck down a new law that gave the U.S. president line-item veto power, the right to cancel indvidual appropriations and tax benefits in legislation already enacted.
* The Republican-led House committee that is investigating campaign fundraising approved rules restricting the influence of Democrats on the panel.
* A Berlin court said Iran's top leaders ordered the killing in September 1992 of exiled Iranian Kurdish dissidents in Berlin.
* The State Department backed away from a plan to remove diplomatic license plates, faced with an uproar from United Nations diplomats over having to pay for parking tickets.
* Retail workers are receiving higher wages but companies are finding other ways besides raising prices to cover the wage increase.
* Congressional budget negotiators tried to get the White House to accept larger tax cuts and cancel some revenue-raising proposals.
* Hillary Clinton said the focus on Whitewater was a fictional conspiracy that was similar to some people's obsession with UFOs.
* News Analysis: Zaire's once powerful president Mobutu Sese Seko faces almost no support abroad or at home.
